"@'
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
rows=json.loads(Path('inputs/intake.json').read_text())
before={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('inputs').iterdir() if p.is_file()}
for r in rows:
 cmd=[sys.executable,'-B','.agents/skills/bio-thesis-formatter/scripts/bio_thesis.py','init','--template',str(Path('inputs')/r['template']),'--output',str(Path('output')/r['output']),'--review-stage','blind','--title-en',r['title_en'],'--major',r['major'],'--author',r['author'],'--student-id',r['student_id']]
 subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
W='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}'
CT='{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types}'
DOCX='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml'
identifiers=[r[k] for r in rows for k in ('author','student_id')]
for r in rows:
 with ZipFile(Path('inputs')/r['template']) as z: base={n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
 with ZipFile(Path('output')/r['output']) as z:
  assert z.testzip() is None
  out={n:z.read(n) for n in z.namelist()}
 assert base.keys()==out.keys()
 replacements={'{{title_en}}':r['title_en'],'{{major}}':r['major'],'{{author}}':'【匿名评审隐去】','{{student_id}}':'【匿名评审隐去】'}
 for n,data in out.items():
  assert not any(s.encode() in data for s in identifiers),(r['output'],n,'identity')
  if not n.endswith(('.xml','.rels')):
   assert data==base[n]
   continue
  a,b=ET.fromstring(base[n]),ET.fromstring(data)
  # Compare every element and property; only placeholder text and DOTX main content type may differ.
  aa,bb=list(a.iter()),list(b.iter())
  assert len(aa)==len(bb)
  for x,y in zip(aa,bb):
   assert x.tag==y.tag
   expected=dict(x.attrib)
   if n=='[Content_Types].xml' and x.get('PartName')=='/word/document.xml':expected['ContentType']=DOCX
   assert expected==y.attrib,(n,'attributes')
   if x.tag"'!=W+'"'t':assert x.text==y.text,(n,'non-text content')
  # Compare paragraph text, allowing replacements split across runs.
  ap,bp=list(a.iter(W+'p')),list(b.iter(W+'p'))
  for x,y in zip(ap,bp):
   expected=''.join(t.text or '' for t in x.iter(W+'t'))
   for token,value in replacements.items():expected=expected.replace(token,value)
   actual=''.join(t.text or '' for t in y.iter(W+'t'))
   assert expected==actual,(n,expected,actual)
  full=''.join(b.itertext())
  assert '{{' not in full,(n,'unfilled marker')
 body=ET.fromstring(out['word/document.xml'])
 text=[''.join(t.text or '' for t in p.iter(W+'t')) for p in body.iter(W+'p')]
 assert 'Candidate: 【匿名评审隐去】' in text
 assert 'Registration: 【匿名评审隐去】' in text
 assert 'Programme: '+r['major'] in text
 assert 'Working title: '+r['title_en'] in text
 print('VERIFIED:',r['output'],'- fields, anonymity, package, original formatting/content/media preserved')
assert before=={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in Path('inputs').iterdir() if p.is_file()}
print('VERIFIED: all input files unchanged')
'@ | python -B -"
